scripts.text: What do you wan te withz me? Be gone!
You have no more business with me, go away!
scripts.translation: 你跟我已经没什么好谈的了，走开！

scripts.text: E'llo mah frien, would I interesst tu with this rare mask? Its value I assure you is real mah frien. Tis manific!
scripts.translation: 嗨，朋友，对这副稀有面具感兴趣吗？我向你保证它绝对物有所值，朋友。真是件好东西！

scripts.text: Ack! Forgez it! I can do bettaz en elsez where!
scripts.translation: 啊！算了！我去别处还能卖得更好！

scripts.text: Wah? O ho ho ho, so you know thaz I steal dis from those savages no? Well I won'tz give it back. But I will for a pricez... wat you say?
scripts.translation: 什么？哦呵呵呵，原来你知道这是我从那些野蛮人那里偷来的？我可不会还给他们。不过你出个价，我倒可以考虑...你说呢？

scripts.text: Ahh a business man are you no?  Fine, how about...
scripts.translation: 啊，你也是个生意人吧？好吧，这个价怎么样...

scripts.text: Hmmm... you drive a hard bargain, ok... my final offer...
scripts.translation: 嗯...你可真会砍价。好吧...这是我的最后报价...

scripts.text: Are youz playin wit me? You don't have ze money!
scripts.translation: 你耍我呢？你根本没那么多钱！

scripts.text: O ho ho, it's a deal, then!
